metadata.title: Electrical Department, Power Distribution & Grid Facilities in Pune
metadata.description: Comprehensive dataset containing geographical coordinates, operational roles, contact information, and jurisdictions for municipal electrical departments (PMC & PCMC), Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL/Mahavitaran) circle and division offices, Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Company Limited (MSETCL/Mahatransco) regional facilities, and the Government of Maharashtra Electrical Inspectorate.

properties.name: PMC Electrical Department Central Head Office
properties.department: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC)
properties.address: Second Floor, Sawarkar Bhavan, Congress House Road, Shivajinagar
properties.role: Apex civic body managing public street lighting network, solar power rooftop installations, electrification of civic hospitals, schools, gardens, crematoriums, electric vehicle (EV) public charging infrastructure, and decorative illumination.

properties.name: PMC Central Street Lighting SCADA & CCMS Control Room
properties.department: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC)
properties.address: 3rd Floor, PMC Main Building Complex, Shivajinagar
properties.role: Centralized Control and Monitoring System (CCMS) operating over 150,000 smart LED streetlights across Pune, automated fault detection, timer switching, and energy conservation tracking.

properties.name: PCMC Electrical Department Headquarters
properties.department: Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation (PCMC)
properties.address: PCMC Main Administrative Building, Mumbai - Pune Road, Pimpri Colony
properties.role: Citywide public illumination, electrical maintenance of municipal water works, sewage treatment plants, civic auditoriums, traffic signal synchronization, and green energy initiatives in Pimpri-Chinchwad.

properties.name: MSEDCL Regional & Ganeshkhind Urban Circle Office (Prakashbhavan)
properties.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (Mahavitaran)
properties.address: 106/A, Senapati Bapat Road, Chaturshringi, Jawahar Nagar, Gokhalenagar
properties.role: Regional administrative headquarters overseeing electricity distribution, billing, high-tension lines, transformer maintenance, and subscriber grievances for Western and Central Pune.

properties.name: MSEDCL Pune Zone Office & Rasta Peth Circle Headquarters (Power House)
properties.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (Mahavitaran)
properties.address: 112, Testing Division, Mudaliar Road, Rasta Peth
properties.role: Zonal headquarters for Pune Urban & Rural Circles, central testing division, high-capacity urban substations, and central emergency response crew for Central & Eastern Pune.

properties.name: MSEDCL Kothrud Division Office
properties.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (Mahavitaran)
properties.address: 1, Paud Road, Near Rambaug Colony, Kothrud
properties.role: Power supply regulation, feeder line breakdown repairs, new connection sanctioning, and billing administration for Kothrud, Bavdhan, Karvenagar, and Warje.

properties.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (Mahavitaran)
properties.address: 14, Sangam Society, Near Pune-Satara Road, Bibwewadi
properties.role: Managing electrical grid, substation transformers, and consumer billing for Bibwewadi, Dhankawadi, Katraj, Ambegaon, and Pune-Satara Road.

properties.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (Mahavitaran)
properties.address: 201, Sinhgad Road, Sarita Vihar, Dattawadi
properties.role: Managing suburban power supply lines, feeder trip repairs, and distribution transformer stations along Sinhgad Road, Dattawadi, and Vadgaon.

properties.name: MSEDCL Bund Garden Division Office
properties.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (Mahavitaran)
properties.address: Exhibition Road, Near General Post Office (GPO), Pune Cantonment
properties.role: Power distribution and high-reliability transmission maintenance for Pune Cantonment (Camp), Bund Garden, Koregaon Park, and Dhole Patil Road.

properties.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (Mahavitaran)

properties.role: Overseeing power supply grids, IT industrial parks, commercial feeders, and residential lines across Yerwada, Kalyani Nagar, Viman Nagar, and Kharadi.

properties.name: MSEDCL Pimpri Circle & Division Office

properties.name: MSEDCL Bhosari Division Office
properties.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (Mahavitaran)
properties.address: General Block, MIDC Bhosari, Pimpri-Chinchwad
properties.role: Heavy industrial feeder power management, high-voltage consumer metering, and infrastructure maintenance across Bhosari MIDC, Chikhali, and Moshi.

properties.name: MSEDCL Hinjewadi & Wakad Sub-Division Office
properties.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (Mahavitaran)
properties.address: Shankar Kalat Nagar, Aundh-Wakad BRTS Road, Wakad
properties.role: Ensuring 24x7 uninterrupted power to Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park (Phases 1, 2, 3), data centers, IT campuses, Wakad, and Punawale residential zones.

properties.name: Office of the Electrical Inspector, Government of Maharashtra (Pune Division)
properties.department: Industries, Energy and Labour Department, Government of Maharashtra
properties.address: Indulal Complex, Lal Bahadur Shastri Road, Lokamanya Nagar, Navi Peth / Sadashiv Peth
properties.role: Statutory authority responsible for electrical safety inspections under Central Electricity Authority (CEA) regulations, licensing of electrical contractors and supervisors, inspection of high-voltage sub-stations, cinema theaters, lifts, and escalators.

properties.name: MSETCL 220kV Flagship Transmission Substation & Division
properties.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Co. Ltd. (Mahatransco)

properties.role: Operating extra high-voltage (220kV/132kV/33kV) power transmission grids, grid sub-stations, and bulk power corridors supplying Hinjewadi IT hub and Western Pune.
